name: Camp Kinderland
description_short: Overnight camp in Tolland with progressive, secular Jewish roots, for campers 9 to 14 plus counselors in training aged 15 and 16. Groups rotate through swimming, sports, arts and crafts, pottery, folk dance, singing, drama and nature, with a social justice theme woven into camp traditions.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim twice a day on a private lake: instructional swim in the morning and free swim in the afternoon. Beginners stay in a shallow area enclosed by the dock and test up to intermediate and deep water. At least three Red Cross certified lifeguards are on duty, and canoes, kayaks and pedal boats are available under supervision.
